notes.title: 6.3 Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Good Day, Capitalists! Here’s what’s new in 6.3.0:

-Game-wide loading and menu speed improvements! Travel to planets and events quicker than a lemon squeeze. It’s Capitalism at its smoothest yet!
-Updates to in-game fonts, making text easier to read on a variety of devices
-Fix for Earth progress resetting
-Additional minor bug fixes

Is that not a humdinger of an update?!! Love it or leave it, we want to hear it! Send your feedback to adventurecapitalist@hyperhippo.ca or stop on in and visit your pals on the Kongregate forums!

The AdVenture Capitalist Team

notes.title: The 6.2 Update has Arrived..In Style!
notes.notes:
Hey there Capitalists! 

Welcome to one our most stylish update yet! We've got thrills! We've got frills! Capitalism has never looked so good. Here’s what’s new in 6.2:

- Mix and match your Suits! Put your wardrobe to work for you by matching different pieces for special bonuses. Whether you're trendy or tacky, you're always fabulous!
- Upgrade Event Badges! That's right; now every Badge will have a bonus and every bonus an upgrade! Talk about a Badge of Honor!
- Collect duplicate Suits and Badges for bigger bonuses! An overflowing closet means an overflowing wallet!
- New and Improved Shop! We've got a fancy new look with fancy new bundles. Even the fanciness got fancier! Now you can shop 'til you drop!
- Fresh new look as we work on making Capitalism faster and fresher than ever!

Is that not a humdinger of an update?!! Love it or leave it, we want to hear it! Send your feedback to adventurecapitalist@hyperhippo.ca or stop on in and share your thoughts on the Steam Community forums!

[b]- The Adventure Capitalist Team[/b]

notes.title: 4.4 UPDATE!

notes.title: 3.3 Update & Live Event "Live Rich and Profit"
notes.notes:
Hi fellow Capitalists,

Welcome to the latest and greatest in Capitalism simulation! As always, let’s get to the heart of the update, as I’m sure you’ve already noticed that you need this version to play the upcoming Space Trade Show Event - “Live Rich and Profit!”

NEW!

* You can now upgrade your Platinum Boost with Mega Bucks!

[b]Additional Dev Notes[/b]

The ability to upgrade the Platinum Boost multiplier should be considered the way to effectively beat Earth and Moon in a reasonable amount of time. We chose to keep these upgrades to only be purchasable with Mega Bucks and not Gold. This system is meant to reward those players who have really put in the time on the planets and in the events. We didn’t want to speed players to the end, and we didn’t want it to be pay to win, so we hope you enjoy the better pacing in the late games, and get a great payoff for stockpiling those hard-earned Mega Bucks. 

As always, please let us know what you think of these changes, as we are constantly fine tuning your overall experience. Take care, and thank you for your continued interest in Capitalism!

[b][i]- The AdVenture Capitalist Team[/i][/b]

notes.title: UPDATE! 3.2 UPDATE: Super Hero Event - 'The Root of All Evil'
notes.notes:
[b]The Root of All Evil event is now live![b] Swing into action and pick a side! Please restart the app and make sure you have the latest update. If you can’t access the event right away, keep restarting from time to time and trying again. You can find more troubleshooting tips here:

https://hyperhippo.zendesk.com/hc/en-us

[b]Good luck![b]

------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Greetings Capitalists, and welcome to version 3.2![/b]

Please update to this version in order to take on the upcoming, ‘Root of All Evil’ Event! You don’t want to miss this epic battle between good and evil. We’ve got some cool new features for you in this update as well!

- Platinum Boost! When you boost an entire planet, you will now unlock a bonus x10 multiplier that’s added to all of your golden boosted investments, making them x17.77! Spoiler alert – For those of you who find the Earth and Moon late game a challenge, we hear you! This feature is just the start of a complete solution we’ve been working on to make things better with the pacing and “complete-ability”.
- Golden Unlocks! Some of you might notice that you have a bit of Gold waiting for you after updating your game. This isn’t a bug! We’ve actually added some gold payouts to select “Everything Unlocks” on Earth only (for now). This should help give you an additional profit boost in your quest for fiscal domination.

[b]Additional Dev Notes[/b]

There were some additional minor features introduced in this release:

- Mega Ticket Gold costs have been reduced to 20 Gold for 1, and 180 Gold for 10!

- We’ve changed how we track and communicate rewarded unlocks like Gold, Badges, and Mega Bucks in Live Events. You’ll now see a Gold Star in a couple of key places. On the main screen, you’ll see it tracking the total # of rewarded unlocks you’ve earned, and in the Unlocks ‘Gallery’ you’ll see the gold star in the corner of their respective unlocks. We wanted you to be able to quickly identify which unlocks had unique payouts when browsing the gallery.

As always, we hope you enjoy the latest AdVenture in Capitalism, and we look forward to your feedback.

Take care, and thanks for your continued interest in capitalism.

[b][i]- The AdVenture Capitalist Team[/i][/b]

notes.title: UPDATE: "Making It Rain" Live Event is LIVE!
notes.notes:
The Making it Rain event is now live! Please make sure you have the latest version of the game, close and reopen your game and you can start playing. If you run into any issues with accessing the event, try a few times to close and reopen your game and checkout our HelpDesk for troubleshooting steps:

https://hyperhippo.zendesk.com/hc/en-us

Good luck!

------------

3.1 RELEASE NOTES

Welcome to the latest and greatest in capitalism simulation - Version 3.1! Please update your game in order to access the upcoming Event - ‘Making it Rain’, which starts March 24th! The Event features a brand new way to boost investments that we are effectively calling, Micromanagement!

We know the question about Earth's end-game is still out there as well. We are still working on adjusting the pacing to this part of the game and we hope to have everything in place for this very soon; ideally the next couple of months. Since this is affecting the largest and most in-depth part of the game, we are making sure the game is balanced in a way that is fun and applicable to the widest range of players, and in a way that doesn't break anyone's experience. It's a long process, but we are working on it and we will get it to you as soon as we can.

For those who have been affected by lost Angel Investors, or the 'Claim Angels' button not functioning, this should be addressed within this new update; however, since your progress is saved locally, we will still need to manually restore any lost progress. 

If you are still having trouble with either of those issues (IE. Switching between planets and losing your Earth progress, can't reset for Angels when you have some to claim), please email us at "Adventurecapitalist@Hyperhippo.ca" and we can help!

Until next time, take care and thanks for your continued interest in Capitalism.

- The AdVenture Capitalist Team

notes.title: 1.1.2: New Achievements, Trading Card System, Linux, and a Game Update!
notes.notes:
*WARNING: CURRENT LAUNCH IS WORKING ONLY IN SELECT RESOLUTIONS (for now!) - SEE LINK BELOW FOR FULL DETAILS:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/346900/discussions/0/541906989395106877/

Since we're still working on the resolution fix, we wanted to at least let you know what is in the newest update! It’s a big mix of stuff, so we’ll break it down into three parts. 

Part 1 - New Achievements and Fixes!

Let’s start this update with an apology! Regarding achievements!

Recently, we updated AdCap with a bunch of new unlocks and achievements for the Earth and Moon - but made a critical oversight. Our “Unlock Everything” Steam Achievement became more difficult to attain, because the criteria for earning it was simply “get everything”.

Well, a lot of players that were close to earning everything had the rug yanked out from under them. This was an oversight, and we want to fix it, so we’re changing the way we do achievements, and we’ve also just added 18 new Steam achievements! 

We’re also implementing a new achievement at the original mark that the Unlock Everything achievement occupied (500 of every Earth Unlock) and we won’t be making achievements whose criteria will change as we continue updating the game. 

Part 2 - Trading cards!! 

In case you haven’t done the whole Steam Trading Cards thing before, here’s how it works. While you play AdCap and spend money/gold on its fine shop purchases, you begin to unlock cards (like a loot drop - the Steam standard for F2P games is spending the equivalent of $9 US in-game to unlock one card). 

Here’s a link to a spiffy page that does a better job explaining stuff: 

http://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards

We’ve created five dandy cards for your enjoyment, along with five badges, five profile backgrounds, five emoticons and the ever-so-clever foil versions of select items. We wish you the best of luck in collecting them, and if you have any suggestions, strong recommendations, demands, threats, or ultimatums regarding cards we want to hear them! Moar? Less? (Please not less). Let us know!

Part 3 - Version 1.1.2!!!

In this update we’ve added some quality of life features on the Moon to make the quest for lunar domination a bit more convenient, and easier on the eyes. The rest of the update is mainly behind the scenes - bug fixing, performance improvements, cloud saving etc. We are working on something big for 1.1.3, more on that as we get closer to that update.

P.S. Some of you have been reporting that Moon progress isn’t saving properly to the Steam Cloud. This should now be fixed. If it continues for you in version 1.1.2, please contact us at adventurecapitalist@hyperhippo.ca for more assistance.

We’ll continue to keep an eye on the Steam community’s expectations for game and platform-related updates going forward. We have a few tweaks left with the Linux build, and then we'll be launching it with the resolution fixes.

Thanks for your understanding and your continued interest in Capitalism.

- The AdVenture Capitalist Team

http://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards

We’ve created five dandy cards for your enjoyment, along with five badges, five profile backgrounds, five emoticons and the ever-so-clever foil versions of select items. We wish you the best of luck in collecting them, and if you have any suggestions, strong recommendations, demands, threats, or ultimatums regarding cards we want to hear them! Moar? Less? (Please not less). Let us know!

Part 3 - Version 1.1.2!!!

In this update we’ve added some quality of life features on the Moon to make the quest for lunar domination a bit more convenient, and easier on the eyes. The rest of the update is mainly behind the scenes - bug fixing, performance improvements, cloud saving etc. We are working on something big for 1.1.3, more on that as we get closer to that update.

P.S. Some of you have been reporting that Moon progress isn’t saving properly to the Steam Cloud. This should now be fixed. If it continues for you in version 1.1.2, please contact us at adventurecapitalist@hyperhippo.ca for more assistance.

We’ll continue to keep an eye on the Steam community’s expectations for game and platform-related updates going forward. We have a few tweaks left with the Linux build, and then we'll be launching it with the resolution fixes.

Thanks for your understanding and your continued interest in Capitalism.

- The AdVenture Capitalist Team

notes.title: AdVenture Capitalist Update: 1.1.1 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hey Capitalists! We’ve got some updates fresh from the factory for you, so buckle up, saddle up, lock and load and put the pedal to the metal! Our apologies for the delay, as we intended to have this update out a lot earlier.

Here’s what we’ve added, tweaked, changed or updated:

* More Moon stuff! - We’ve also added some new achievements, upgrades, and managers for your businesses! You may notice there’s quite a few upgrades/that the new managers have the same price. This is intentional! The choice of which to upgrade is yours to make!

* New achievements for Earth - you knew it was coming! The Earth endgame has been extended, and we’re very very sorry if you were close to the end before.  Progress! 

* Moon modifications - we’ve adjusted a bunch of the values for the Moon, and changed how the Mid to Late game flows. All of our changes were to make things go faster, but not TOO much faster. The Moon remains a tough nut to crack, but it shouldn’t feel like a soggy slug slog. Speaking of the Moon…

* Orange Dot - we fixed the way the Orange Dots work. They used to tell you whenever you had something new to buy, and wouldn’t shut up about it until you bought it. This was a mistake. NOW they tell you when you have something new, and go away once you’ve looked at what it is. Useful and cathartic for you OCD types!

* End Game celebration - we added some confetti and stuff for players that reach the end. Good job! Escape while you can! D:

* Angel Reset suggestions - there’s more info now about when to reset, which is mostly to help new players get the hang of it. If Louis Fitui shows up and starts talking about resetting for angels, or if you notice the Orange Dot flashing when you can double your angels, that’s the ticket. 

That’s it for now. We’ve got some more info on this and the previous update located at http://adventurecapitalistofficial.tumblr.com, where we’ll go over some of the tweaks in more detail. This is to try and reduce some of the confusion we cause when our tweaks don’t make sense at first glance. 

Thanks for your continued interest in Capitalism! 
—
- The AdVenture Capitalist Team
